up: For document CHEMBL4613209, list all compounds reported in that document. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4613209'
